Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.
  • Major course grades At least C in the requirements under the catalog major section, including its listed foundations and other named major sections.
